subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle(...)` ship as a supported generic Plugin SDK/runtime contract for owner-coordinated session rotation, or should Teams use a narrower non-public core seam?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but adding a public session lifecycle mutation primitive creates a durable third-party API commitment that automated review cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Accept the documented owner-gated API as the canonical plugin path for externally observed session lifecycle boundaries.

options.title: Narrow the surface before merge
options.body: Keep the atomic core lifecycle owner but remove the public callable and expose only the smallest Teams-required internal or scoped runtime path.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Accept the documented owner-gated API as the canonical plugin path for externally observed session lifecycle boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the behavior-scoping follow-up and is the strongest available routing candidate for the final contract decision.
